name: copilot-generation-055a8d5
description: Generation benchmark for this project's own source code and documentation at commit 055a8d5 (snapshot data/snapshots/a282ec471ebf1387cb4feafcfe732ad24a431c7a/tree, reference index 4aaeab9c650ab76c). The 34 answerable questions reuse the exact text and ground-truth regions of retrieval benchmark copilot-self-055a8d5 and add source-supported key facts; 8 unanswerable questions test abstention. Key facts were written from the sealed region text only, without looking at any model response or any retrieval result.
contamination_notes: The repository may be public and could be present in a model's training data, in which case the plain arm may answer from memorised code. The questions were written by the repository's author; the retrieval benchmark file (without key facts) is part of the snapshot. A plain-LLM advantage on this repository therefore cannot be separated from memorisation, and the synthetic repository exists to give an unfamiliar comparison.
limitations: Not independent: the project author wrote the code, the questions and the key facts, so results are optimistic and cannot show generalisation.
34 answerable and 8 unanswerable questions: differences of a few questions are within noise.
Key facts are the author's reading of function-sized regions; an answer can be correct yet phrase facts differently, which is why grading is semantic (judge or human), not keyword matching.
Unanswerable questions are about operational or process facts that do not exist in the repository; they test abstention, not near-miss discrimination.
tests/, data/ and submission/ are excluded from the index, matching the retrieval benchmark.
